name: The Lost Treasure of Aquila
description: The siblings Sam and Minna and their mother Eva arrive to the Orchid coast to celebrate Christmas in the sun with aunt Anja and their cousin Bianca. It's the first time after their father's death the siblings are back on his beloved Orchid coast, and it is in the same time both beautiful and sad to be there. It promises to be an exciting Christmas when a mysterious mask and old pieces of wood from a sunken ship washes ashore at the hotel where they live.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Siblings Sam and Minna and their mother come to the Orchid Coast to celebrate Christmas in the sun with Aunt Anja and their cousin Bianca. When a storm breaks loose, something unexpected happens.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Old wreckage and a mysterious mask have washed ashore at the hotel where Sam, Minna and Bianca are staying. Where do the things come from?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Sam, Minna and their mother Eva learn that the Orchid Coast will be destroyed after Christmas. Can the pirate Aquila's treasure save the coast?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Sam, Minna and Bianca have decided to dive on the wreck of the Aquila and find the treasure, before the shady guys camping on the beach do.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: While Eva welcomes new troublesome guests to the hotel, the cousins ​​desperately try to open the locked box, in search of Aquila's treasure.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: It's an excursion to the Nikola Monastery, and Sam, Minna and Bianca go along to look for clues to Aquila's treasure. But Bert and Fatima are hot on their heels.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Sam, Minna and Bianca are secretly searching all the rooms in the hotel for the missing code key.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Bert and Fatima show up at the hotel's Christmas coffee and demand that the children give them all the clues about the treasure.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The cousins ​​find a fun and slightly disgusting way to sneak out of their lessons with Miss Gunnel. All in order to search for the first clue to the treasure.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The cousins have found the first clue to the treasure, but they must not rest for it. Where does the next clue lead? How should they be able to figure out what it means?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Sam and Minna are looking for the herb they need for the treasure hunt with the help of their mother Eva. But they are not alone in the forest.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The cousins ​​spend a day together with Stefan, who is in love with Eva. Minna is suspicious of Stefan. Does she have reason to be?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Sam, Minna and Bianca convince Anja and Eva to let them have a look on the other side of the island, where the Cave of Death happens to be located.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: The cousins, who don't know that Johnny is a villain, have helped him get to the cave of death.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Johnny has taken the sword from Sam and Minna and left them bound in the Cave of Death.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Sam, Minna and Bianca have a plan - they are going to steal Aquila's sword from Bert and Fatima!

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Sam, Minna and Bianca set off to search for a special well on the territory of the evil company Holtexz.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Sam, Minna and Bianca must somehow get into Holtexz's area to find Aquila's well where the treasure map is to be found.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Sam, Minna and Bianca have been caught red-handed by Holtexz's guards. What will happen to the cousins ​​now?

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Stefan has managed to convince Eva not to go back to Sweden with the children. But can Stefan really be trusted? And how will Sam and Minna be able to become friends again?

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: The children have all three things that will help them find the treasure. But the Christmas play's genre rehearsal gets in the way of the treasure hunt.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Sam, Minna and Bianca have found Aquila's binoculars but are being chased by Alexandra and Leonora. But how will an old binoculars be able to save the Orchid coast? It's in a hurry, because soon the coast will start to be torn down.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Sam, Minna and Bianca understand that Aquila's binoculars can make dreams come true. And all they dream of is saving the Orchid Coast. But how will it happen? And how will they manage to do it?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Sam, Minna and Bianca have found Aquila's magical binoculars, and together with Eva have saved the Orchid Coast forever. Now they can celebrate Christmas in peace and quiet... or not?
